Corn Tortilla Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 11:37pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 doz. corn tortillas
Sm. can Ortega green chili
Sm. can tomato sauce
Lg. can tuna
Cheese, Jack, cheddar

Preparation

1 Warm tortillas, cut them and the chili stripes. In casserole dish start layering with tortillas, tuna, chili, cheese and tomato sauce. Start with tortillas again and so on. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Cover with foil for first 15 minutes.
